question: Conditional on exact wet activation depth k and fixed stop-level q, is the realised active-stop subset more topologically dispersed along the 10-stop route than expected?

known_before_contract.rc6_primary: Within-taxon multi-site concentration exceeds the principal species-response + prior-site-history comparator.
known_before_contract.lag_profile: Residual dependence remains positive at stop-number lags 7-9 but declines modestly from near lags.
known_before_contract.coordinate_qc: Exact-distance profile is non-authoritative because raw SiteID coordinates contain gross transcription errors.
known_before_contract.deep_template: Deep k>=4 activity preferentially aligns with recurrent strong-chorus SiteIDs in a post-hoc exact-k analysis.

population.base: Exactly the 2,835 ERA5-weather-eligible strictly-prior-history focal pairs used by the strongest post-hoc comparator.
population.cluster: Taxa acoustically silent at all ten drier-run stops and active at k>=2 wetter-run stops.
population.topology: Ten ordered route positions as represented by the aligned stop columns; positions are indexed 1..10.

fixed_q.source: The same cross-fitted 72-h rainfall + strictly-prior SiteID history + dry-persistence + pair-incidence-matching q used by the strongest post-hoc comparator.
fixed_q.conditioning: Fix observed k exactly for each eligible taxon x route-night cluster. Randomize only which k route positions are active.
fixed_q.subset_probability: Exact independent-Bernoulli conditional distribution: subset weight proportional to the product of q/(1-q) odds for included positions.

primary.name: mean_pairwise_stop_separation
primary.definition: For active ordered positions A with k>=2, mean of |i-j| over all unordered active-position pairs.
primary.cluster_excess: observed metric minus exact E[metric | k, fixed q].
primary.aggregation: Mean cluster excess over all eligible clusters.

secondary.name: topological_span
secondary.definition: max(active position)-min(active position), range 1..9 for k>=2.

secondary.name: contiguous_component_count
secondary.definition: Number of contiguous runs of active positions after sorting positions 1..10.

null.primary_p: plus-one upper-tail probability from clusterwise exact-k subset draws aggregated to the mean excess.

interpretation.positive_primary: The realised multi-site behavioural response is more dispersed along route topology than expected from exact activation depth and the strongest stop-level q alone.
interpretation.null_primary: Multi-site depth exists, but the route-topological arrangement is adequately described by exact k plus fixed q; do not claim additional landscape dispersion.
boundary: Route-topology separation is not exact geographic distance.
Survey order is confounded with stop-number topology.
No movement, connectivity, hydrological pathway, acoustic propagation, or social mechanism is identified.
Result is post-hoc hypothesis generation and cannot upgrade RC6.

anti_tuning: Do not replace mean pairwise stop separation as the primary metric after readback.
Do not change k>=2 eligibility, q source, exact-k conditioning, seed, replicate count or upper-tail direction after readback.
Do not introduce coordinate-based exclusions or repairs after seeing topology outcomes.
Do not promote this analysis into RC6.
